name: context-rings
description: A ring per active session above the prompt, filled by how much of its context window is used; newest activity first, hover for the name

contextWindow.title: Session context window
contextWindow.description: The window each session's ring fills against.

mainYellow.title: Session ring turns yellow at
mainYellow.description: Percent of the session context window.

mainRed.title: Session ring turns red at
mainRed.description: Percent of the session context window.

hoverContext.title: Context used on hover
hoverContext.description: What a session's hover label says about its context, as in 620K, 620K (62%) or 620K of 1M (62%). The ring's fill already shows it.

subagentLimit.title: Subagent limit
subagentLimit.description: The limit a subagent's dot is measured against.

subagentYellow.title: Subagent dot appears (yellow) at
subagentYellow.description: Percent of the subagent limit. Below this a subagent is not shown.

subagentRed.title: Subagent dot turns red (and toasts) at
subagentRed.description: Percent of the subagent limit. A toast warns once per subagent when it gets here.

cacheWarnHour.title: 1-hour cache: warn before it expires
cacheWarnHour.description: How long before a session's 1-hour prompt cache runs out its ring pulses, shows a countdown arc, and you get a toast.

cacheWarnFiveMin.title: 5-minute cache: warn before it expires
cacheWarnFiveMin.description: How long before a session's 5-minute prompt cache runs out its ring pulses, shows a countdown arc, and you get a toast.

cacheWarnMin.title: Cache warning only for sessions over
cacheWarnMin.description: Smaller sessions are cheap to cache again, so they get no warning.
